Subject: Multi-entity billing + VAT ID batch validation for Skylab

Hi Marta,

Thanks again for the call this morning — helpful to understand Skylab's split-entity setup in the EU (Skylab NL for platform fees, Skylab ES for professional services). Two items we want to resolve so Finance can release the October invoices and unblock payment:

1) VAT ID validation: you mentioned you can share a single export of customers and VAT IDs for our reconciliation. If you can send the list (CSV) we'll run a batch UID/validation check and highlight mismatches or expired IDs.

2) Reverse-charge (RC) handling: for platform fees billed on Skylab NL but consumed by Skylab ES customers, we need evidence of business-to-business (B2B) status and a statement to apply RC on the invoice. If you can provide a sample RC confirmation (signed PDF) we can adjust the next invoice run and reissue corrected documents.

Proposed next steps from our side:
- You send the CSV with columns: entity, customer_name, customer_vat_id, country, contact_email. (Preferably masked SSNs/IDs if any.)
- We run the batch validation (VAT ID + syntax checks + VIES where applicable) and return a report with three buckets: valid, review, invalid.
- For "review" items we’ll ask for additional proof (certificate of business status, VAT registration doc).

Timeline: we can complete the batch validation and return the report in 48 business hours after we receive the CSV. If confirmed, we can reissue the corrected invoices (with RC note) within 3 business days.

I attached a short sample report template and a sample RC evidence PDF to show the fields we need.

Attachments: skylab_vat_template.csv (CSV template), rc_evidence_sample.pdf (PDF)

Can you confirm you’ll send the export by EOD tomorrow? Also please CC accounts-payable@skylab.ai so we can coordinate the reissue and payment timing.

Best,
Ben

Hi Marta — appreciate the quick turnaround and the files (received). Quick answers inline and next steps: 

- UK VAT IDs: our validator treats GB differently; we'll flag them as outside EU and run HMRC checks where available. We'll mark those records as "GB-check" in the report.
- Spain: for the review bucket we can accept the Skylab self-attestation as a temporary measure (to release the current hold) but for permanent RC treatment we need the official VAT registration extract or a signed PO/contract referencing business status. We'll mark temporary acceptances in the report and flag items needing official docs.
- Split invoices: yes — Redwood can emit two invoice lines per customer and attach a consolidated remittance advice PDF that summarizes both billing entities for reconciliation. We'll include a mapping table in the remittance PDF showing invoice numbers per entity.

Planned deliverables: 
1) VAT validation report (CSV + summary) with bucketed statuses.
2) Reissued invoices with RC note for confirmed items and a consolidated remittance advice.
3) A short checklist for accounts-payable listing required evidence for the "review" bucket.

Timeline update: we will run the batch today and send the validation report by 2026-11-06 18:00 UTC. If you want us to proceed with reissues automatically for "valid" bucket only, please confirm. Otherwise we'll wait for your go-ahead.

Also CC'ing Marissa (billing operations) to confirm invoice formatting for the consolidated remittance file.

Thanks,
Ben
